title: Multi-account security foundation
problem: Separate production, non-production, security and log responsibilities while maintaining centralized identity, guardrails, evidence and break-glass recovery.

requirements.availability: Identity and security operations retain documented recovery paths
requirements.security: Federated workforce access, least privilege, immutable central logs, preventive and detective guardrails
requirements.cost: Account-level ownership and allocation without duplicating unnecessary shared services

architecture.summary: AWS Organizations separates workload and security accounts; IAM Identity Center provides federated access; organization trails and security findings flow to protected accounts.

decisions: Account vending, ownership and closure are automated and documented
Human access is federated and temporary; log archive administration is separated
Break-glass paths are isolated, monitored and exercised
Central services are selected only where centralization improves scale or control
Account ownership and cost allocation are mandatory at creation
Unused accounts and retained data follow lifecycle policy

failure_modes.detection: Authentication failures and identity health signals
failure_modes.mitigation: Use monitored break-glass access under incident authorization
failure_modes.prevention: Tested emergency path, multiple responsible operators and protected credentials

failure_modes.mitigation: Restore delivery and preserve alternate evidence
failure_modes.prevention: Protected trail configuration, alerts and periodic validation

decisions.decision: Separate log archive and security tooling accounts from workloads
decisions.trade_off: Operational complexity increases while blast radius and administrative conflict decrease

decisions.decision: Use federated short-lived sessions instead of IAM users
decisions.trade_off: Identity provider availability becomes an explicit dependency
decisions.revisit_when: Identity architecture or machine-access requirements change

verification: Provision a sandbox account through the approved process
Trace one activity event to central logs
